task_text: IKEA MuJoCo BURVIK side table (IKEA BURVIK side table (AA-2445102-1), seven operations) with two 7-DoF Franka Panda arms, each with the MuJoCo Menagerie Panda hand (two-finger, tendon-coupled). Assemble the BURVIK side table: screw two legs into the upside-down top, turn the top on its side, push the handle through the two remaining top holes, screw the other two legs into the handle's sleeves, and turn the table upright. Success requirements: All five retention joints (the four legs and the handle to the top) are latched. Every leg and the handle is at its assembled pose in the top's frame: gap within 0.8 mm, lateral within 1 mm, tilt within 2 degrees (legs: thread axis; handle: full rotation, both rod ends within 1 mm of the two top holes), relative speed below 0.025 m/s. The top ends upright: its normal within 2 degrees of world +z. The benchmark's terminal rules, the same in every IKEA MuJoCo task, come on top of these requirements. When your rows end: (1) the requirements above hold; (2) the parts are released: no robot link touches any part; (3) every part is at rest: at most 0.01 m/s and 0.05 rad/s; (4) the simulation never broke down: no non-finite state, no MuJoCo BADQACC / BADQPOS / BADQVEL warning, no contact of a part deeper than 10 mm, at any time. The grader then holds your last row for 1.0 s more and requires (1)-(4) again at its end. Mechanism: Each leg end is a right-hand M8 thread (1 mm lead, SDF mesh) in an SDF nut: about 12.5 turns from first engagement to the seat. Retention welds (legs and handle to the top) switch on once the scene's gates hold for 0.15 s.
